content_sections.heading: BPCL Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited has announced 49 indicative vacancies under the BPCL PwBD Special Recruitment Drive 2026. The highest number of vacancies is for Associate Executive (Engineering), with 33 posts, followed by Junior Executive (Accounts), Associate Executive (Official Language – Hindi) and Associate Executive (Quality Assurance). Note: The 49 vacancies are indicative. BPCL reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions based on organisational requirements. The recruitment is exclusively for eligible PwBD candidates with disability categories identified as suitable for the respective posts.

content_sections.heading: BPCL PwBD Recruitment 2026 Disability Eligibility
content_sections.text: The BPCL Special Recruitment Drive 2026 is exclusively for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. Candidates must possess a permanent benchmark disability of at least 40% in a specified category suitable for their chosen post and a valid disability certificate issued by the competent medical authority.

rows.disability_description: Locomotor Disability, Including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims and Muscular Dystrophy
Autism, Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability and Mental Illness
Multiple Disabilities from Categories A to D, Including Deaf-Blindness

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for BPCL Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying for BPCL Recruitment 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the educational qualification, minimum marks, age limit, work experience and PwBD eligibility requirements for their selected position. All four advertised profiles require relevant post-qualification work experience. The recruitment is restricted to candidates with the prescribed permanent benchmark disabilities. No. Freshers are not eligible for the BPCL Special Recruitment Drive 2026 because all four advertised positions require relevant post-qualification work experience. Associate Executive (Engineering), Associate Executive (Official Language – Hindi) and Associate Executive (Quality Assurance) posts require at least three years of relevant experience. Junior Executive (Accounts) requires at least five years of post-qualification experience in Finance or related functions.

content_sections.heading: BPCL Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The BPCL Recruitment 2026 eligibility conditions vary according to the executive profile. Candidates must possess the prescribed academic qualifications, relevant work experience and a permanent benchmark disability suitable for the selected position. The cut-off date for determining age and other eligibility conditions is 1 October 2026. Candidates applying for the 33 Associate Executive (Engineering) positions must possess a full-time B.E., B.Tech or B.Sc Engineering Degree in the prescribed discipline from a recognised university or institution. The minimum aggregate marks are 55%, relaxed to 50% for SC/ST candidates. Applicants who completed the Engineering Degree through a three-year lateral-entry course after a Diploma are also eligible. At least three years of relevant post-qualification experience is mandatory. The notification recognises experience in specified industrial sectors, including petroleum, oil and gas, refineries, petrochemicals, chemical manufacturing, power, renewable energy, infrastructure and other listed manufacturing industries. Candidates applying for eight Junior Executive (Accounts) vacancies must possess Graduation in any discipline with at least 55% aggregate marks, relaxed to 50% for SC/ST candidates, along with CA Intermediate or CMA Intermediate qualification. A minimum of five years of relevant post-qualification experience in Finance, Accounts, Taxation, Cost Accounting, Auditing or related functions is required. Important: Candidates who have passed the CA Final or CMA Final examination are not eligible for this Junior Executive (Accounts) recruitment. Articleship or practical training forming part of the CA/CMA curriculum will not be counted towards the required experience. For Associate Executive (Official Language – Hindi), candidates must possess a full-time Master's Degree in Hindi with at least 55% aggregate marks, relaxed to 50% for SC/ST candidates. They must also have studied English as a subject in Class 12 or Graduation with at least 50% marks. Applicants must possess at least three years of post-qualification experience in translation from English to Hindi and Hindi to English. Candidates should also be familiar with the implementation of the Government of India's Official Language policy. Candidates applying for four Associate Executive (Quality Assurance) vacancies must possess a full-time M.Sc Chemistry Degree or an accepted specialisation such as Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry or Polymer Chemistry from a recognised university. The minimum aggregate marks are 55%, relaxed to 50% for SC/ST candidates. A minimum of three years of relevant post-qualification laboratory experience in the Petroleum, Oil and Gas, Petrochemical or Chemical industry is required. content_sections.heading: BPCL Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The BPCL Executive Salary 2026 depends on the selected position. Junior Executive (Accounts) carries a pay scale of Rs.30,000–1,20,000 under Grade E0, with an approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) of Rs.12.38 lakh at the minimum pay. Associate Executive positions carry a pay scale of Rs.40,000–1,40,000 under Grade E1, with an approximate annual CTC of Rs.17.25 lakh at the minimum pay. Selected candidates will be inducted at the minimum of the applicable pay scale. In addition to basic pay, employees may receive Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, perks, retirement benefits and Performance Related Pay according to BPCL policy. Note: CTC represents the approximate annual employment cost and should not be confused with monthly in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: BPCL Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The BPCL Recruitment 2026 selection process may involve multiple stages, including application screening, Computer Based Test (CBT), Case Based Discussion, Group Task, Personal Interview, document verification and pre-employment medical examination. The exact stages may vary depending on the profile and the number of applications received. BPCL may shortlist applicants based on their educational qualification, relevant work experience and other requirements specified for the selected profile. Eligible shortlisted candidates may be required to appear for the Computer Based Test. The notified CBT covers Verbal Ability, Quantitative Aptitude and Logical Reasoning. The Quality Assurance profile also includes a Professional Knowledge section. Depending on the selection process adopted, candidates shortlisted through the CBT may be called for a Case Based Discussion or Group Task. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for a Personal Interview. BPCL will assess factors such as relevant experience, professional achievements and performance in the applicable selection stages. Provisionally selected candidates must undergo the prescribed pre-employment medical examination conducted by BPCL-authorised medical officers or nominated hospitals. Final appointment is subject to satisfying the applicable medical standards.

content_sections.text: The BPCL CBT Exam Pattern 2026 varies according to the position. The Engineering, Accounts and Official Language profiles have a general aptitude paper comprising 100 questions for 100 marks with a duration of 120 minutes. The Quality Assurance profile additionally includes Professional Knowledge and has a different examination structure. Exam Duration: 120 Minutes. Exam Language: English Only. content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BPCL Recruitment 2026 must upload legible scanned documents supporting their qualifications, work experience, disability status and other eligibility claims. The official notification specifies the following important documents. Date of Birth Proof such as Class 10, Class 12 or Birth Certificate Consolidated Marksheet and Degree / Diploma Certificate Relevant Professional Qualification Certificates Work Experience / Service Certificates on Employer Letterhead Valid PwBD Disability Certificate SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS Certificate, If Applicable Ex-Servicemen Certificate, If Applicable Recent Colour Passport-Size Photograph Not Older Than September 2026 Scanned Signature Latest Three Salary Slips from Current Employer Prescribed Scribe / Reader Certificates and Undertakings, If Applicable The employer-issued experience certificates must contain details such as the candidate's designation, service period, nature of employment, work responsibilities and remuneration information. The notification requires a certificate for each organisation whose experience is claimed.

content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Scribe / Reader Facility
content_sections.text: Candidates must declare the need for a scribe in the online application and submit the required documents according to BPCL instructions. Eligible candidates using a scribe may receive compensatory time of 20 minutes for each hour of examination or as otherwise advised. content_sections.heading: BPCL Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The BPCL Apply Online 2026 process started on 9 November 2026 for 49 indicative executive vacancies under the Special Recruitment Drive for PwBD candidates. Eligible applicants must complete the online registration through the official BPCL recruitment portal by 29 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The recruitment includes Engineering, Accounts, Hindi and Quality Assurance positions. BPCL Recruitment 2026: Click to Apply Online Important: BPCL accepts applications only through the prescribed online process. Candidates are not required to send a printed application form or documents by post. Eligible candidates can apply online through the BPCL Careers website or the official IBPS registration link. Follow the steps below. Important: Candidates cannot modify their application information after completing registration. BPCL advises applicants to carefully verify all information before final submission.

content_sections.heading: BPCL Probation and Job Location 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates selected under BPCL Recruitment 2026 will be placed on probation for one year. The probation period may be extended if performance is found unsatisfactory. Successful candidates will be considered for confirmation according to BPCL's policies. Selected candidates may be posted at BPCL offices, refineries, business locations, joint ventures or subsidiary organisations across India. The positions are transferable according to the requirements of the Corporation, and employees may be required to perform shift duties.
